prompt: sphinx texinfo_documents multiple authors separator markup
answer:
Use Texinfo markup `@*` as the separator between multiple authors:

```python
texinfo_documents = [
    (
        "index",
        "project",
        "Project title",
        "John@*Sarah",
        "Project",
        "Project description.",
        "Documentation tools",
        True,
    ),
]
```

The Sphinx documentation specifies: “Use `@*` to separate multiple authors, as in: `John@*Sarah`.”
